No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are only used for data preprocessing (extracting legal elements) but not for evaluating generated outputs.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on legal case retrieval reformulated as legal element generation. The NLG aspect is generating key legal elements that should appear in relevant cases. The evaluation is primarily retrieval-focused using Precision@5 rather than traditional NLG metrics. The paper uses LLMs for data preprocessing but not for evaluation.
